definition.en: The Socio Economic and Caste Census (SECC) is a comprehensive study of the socio-economic status of rural and urban households in India, designed to identify beneficiaries for government welfare schemes.
definition.hi: The Socio Economic and Caste Census (SECC) is a comprehensive study of the socio-economic status of rural and urban households in India, designed to identify beneficiaries for government welfare schemes.

importanceInUpsc.en: SECC is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it provides the empirical data foundation for poverty estimation, social welfare targeting, and inclusive growth strategies. Understanding its methodology and limitations is essential for analyzing policy implementation and the effectiveness of government interventions in the Indian economy.
